findings: Resolution, channel order, and [0,1] conversion are aligned between the recovered evaluator and the checkpoint preprocessor contract.
The checkpoint preprocessor records VISUAL=IDENTITY; image normalization is therefore not an independent runtime mismatch in the evaluator.

No direct image preprocessing mismatch was found. The training use_imagenet_stats flag is consistent with the saved preprocessor/model contract, but its exact trainer-side application remains a lower-level implementation detail not proven by this read-only audit.
